description:
* Support the development of HSE policies and programs.
* Advise and instruct on various safety-related topics.
* Conduct risk assessment and enforce preventative measures.
* Review existing policies and measures and update according to legislation.
* Initiate and organize EHS (Occupational Health Services) training of employees.
* Inspect premises and the work of personnel to identify issues or non-conformity.
* Oversee installations, maintenance, disposal of substances, etc.
* Stop any unsafe acts or processes that seem dangerous or unhealthy.
* Record and investigate incidents to determine causes and handle worker’s compensation claims.
* Submit the government the regular report on safety and environment according to law’s requirements.
* Conduct safety inspection regularly at workplace.
* Responsible for managing environmental facility licenses (environmental impact assessment report, etc.).
* 5S activities follow- up.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor’s degree in Safety Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.
* Conversational level in English.
* 1 year of experience in a similar position and function in a multinational company.
* Experience in the professional field of Health, Safety and Environment in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in metal manufacturing industries is desirable.
* Experienced with authorized users of machines, forklifts and other equipment.
* Good negotiation and communication skills.
* Good analytical, influencing and organizing skills.
* Confident in dealing with Health, Safety and Environment matters.
